pred_texts: Instruct: Get a large skillet and add three tablespoons of olive oil to it.
Feedback: You are using a teaspoon to measure the olive oil, but the recipe requires three tablespoons. This will result in using significantly less oil than intended.
Instruct: Now turn on the heat to medium-low.
Instruct: Next, let's get four carrots and wash them. Carrots should be medium-sized.
Instruct: Now cut off the green ends of the carrot.
Instruct: Now peel the skin off of the carrots. You can also cut the ends off the carrots.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now you can wash the carrots again.
Instruct: Now let's cut the carrots lengthwise into halves. You can cut them into half and then cut them lengthwise.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now add the carrots carefully to the pan. Make sure they are all lengthwise and evenly spread.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now we can set the heat to medium-high. Let the carrots cook for about three minutes.
Instruct: Now set the heat to medium-low.
Instruct: Let the carrots cook for about six minutes.
Instruct: Now let's add the remaining ingredients. First drizzle honey on top of the carrots directly, as per taste.
Instruct: Now let's drizzle two teaspoons of soy sauce on top of the carrots.
Instruct: Now let's add the remaining ingredient, which is an onion. Let's get medium sized onion and chop half of it into small pieces.
Instruct: You can now add the onions to the pan with the carrots.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now give the onions and the carrots in the pan a nice stir, so that they are well mixed together.
Success: Step complete.
